summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser as requested. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier) and the SHACLPathError exception, following the seven-step procedure in the spec. Added test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with 41 parametrized and direct test cases covering all valid forms, each error branch, None and plain-string inputs, a Literal, an open-tailed RDF list, and graph immutability. Results: 42 tests pass (41 new plus test/test_path.py). Caveats: a nested alternative flattens to p1 | p2 | p3 because AlternativePath flattens its arguments, and my first test expectation was corrected to match. mypy, black, isort, and ruff are not installed in the shared venv, so type checking and formatting were not run; line lengths were checked with awk and type-ignore placement was reviewed by reading. Nothing was committed.
